One Campus. One Ambassador. Unlimited Opportunities.

If you have the passion to lead, apply now and become the Official ISJ Campus Ambassador for your Law College, Department of Law, or University.

Become the Face of Your Campus!
Wanna be a Campus Ambassador?

The Indic School of Jurisprudence (ISJ) is inviting enthusiastic law students to represent ISJ in their Law College, Department of Law, or University as Campus Ambassadors.

As an ISJ Campus Ambassador, you'll:
Develop Leadership & Communication Skills
Build Confidence & Critical Thinking
Access Exclusive Internships & Opportunities
Network with Law Students, Advocates & Legal Professionals
Enhance your Moot Court, ADR & Advocacy Skills

This is more than a title it's an opportunity to lead, learn, connect, and grow while creating a positive impact on your campus.

📌 Apply Now:
 https://lnkd.in/gSFTE-ka

Last Date: 15 August 2026 | 11:59 PM

Apply today and become the Official ISJ Campus Ambassador for your Law College, Department of Law, or University.

Tag your friends, share this opportunity, and help us build a stronger legal community across India.
Practice • Analyze • Improve • Succeed
